turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I saw your work on LinkedIn. My name is Suresh Patil. I’m in Nashik — would you be able to take on a project here? I want to redo my home office and study.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling. We only work in Pune and PCMC at the moment — we don’t have the vendor network to take on projects outside Pune.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not even for a smaller project?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Even for a smaller project, our execution depends on our contractors being on-site. I’m sorry we can’t help.
